SELECT * FROM( SELECT NOMEUSU, PERC, SUM(VALOR_TOTAL) AS VALOR_TOTAL, SUM(VALOR_PERIODO) AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM( SELECT USU.NOMEUSU, (SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO)/ ( SELECT SUM(EAC2.QTDPERIODO) FROM TRDEAC EAC2 ) ) * 100 AS PERC, (CASE WHEN :TIPO = 'T' THEN SUM(EAC.QTDGERAL) END) AS VALOR_TOTAL, 0 AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM TRDPCO PCO INNER JOIN TRDEAC EAC ON(PCO.VALOR = EAC.RESOURCEID) INNER JOIN TRDCON CON ON(CON.NUCONTROLE = PCO.NUCONTROLE) INNER JOIN TSIUSU USU ON(USU.CODUSU = EAC.CODUSU) WHERE ((USU.CODUSU= :CODUSU) OR (:CODUSU IS NULL)) AND (UPPER(CON.DESCRCONTROLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || :TELA || '%') OR (:TELA IS NULL)) AND :TIPO = 'T' GROUP BY USU.NOMEUSU
UNION ALL
SELECT USU.NOMEUSU, (SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO)/ ( SELECT SUM(EAC2.QTDPERIODO) FROM TRDEAC EAC2 ) ) * 100 AS PERC, 0 AS VALOR_TOTAL, (CASE WHEN :TIPO = 'P' THEN SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO) END) AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM TRDPCO PCO INNER JOIN TRDEAC EAC ON(PCO.VALOR = EAC.RESOURCEID) INNER JOIN TRDCON CON ON(CON.NUCONTROLE = PCO.NUCONTROLE) INNER JOIN TSIUSU USU ON(USU.CODUSU = EAC.CODUSU) WHERE ((USU.CODUSU= :CODUSU) OR (:CODUSU IS NULL)) AND (UPPER(CON.DESCRCONTROLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || :TELA || '%') OR (:TELA IS NULL)) AND :TIPO = 'P' GROUP BY USU.NOMEUSU ) GROUP BY NOMEUSU, PERC ORDER BY VALOR_TOTAL DESC, VALOR_PERIODO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM < 51

SELECT OPC_MENU, PERC, SUM(VALOR_TOTAL) AS VALOR_TOTAL, SUM(VALOR_PERIODO) AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM( SELECT CON.DESCRCONTROLE AS OPC_MENU, (SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO)/ ( SELECT SUM(EAC2.QTDPERIODO) FROM TRDEAC EAC2 ) ) * 100 AS PERC, (CASE WHEN :TIPO = 'T' THEN SUM(EAC.QTDGERAL) END) AS VALOR_TOTAL, 0 AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM TRDPCO PCO INNER JOIN TRDEAC EAC ON(PCO.VALOR = EAC.RESOURCEID) INNER JOIN TRDCON CON ON(CON.NUCONTROLE = PCO.NUCONTROLE) INNER JOIN TSIUSU USU ON(USU.CODUSU = EAC.CODUSU) WHERE ((USU.CODUSU= :CODUSU) OR (:CODUSU IS NULL))
AND (UPPER(CON.DESCRCONTROLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || :TELA || '%') OR (:TELA IS NULL)) AND :TIPO = 'T' AND USU.NOMEUSU = :USUARIO GROUP BY CON.DESCRCONTROLE
UNION ALL
SELECT CON.DESCRCONTROLE AS OPC_MENU, (SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO)/ ( SELECT SUM(EAC2.QTDPERIODO) FROM TRDEAC EAC2 ) ) * 100 AS PERC, 0 AS VALOR_TOTAL, (CASE WHEN :TIPO = 'P' THEN SUM(EAC.QTDPERIODO) END) AS VALOR_PERIODO FROM TRDPCO PCO INNER JOIN TRDEAC EAC ON(PCO.VALOR = EAC.RESOURCEID) INNER JOIN TRDCON CON ON(CON.NUCONTROLE = PCO.NUCONTROLE) INNER JOIN TSIUSU USU ON(USU.CODUSU = EAC.CODUSU) WHERE ((USU.CODUSU= :CODUSU) OR (:CODUSU IS NULL))
AND (UPPER(CON.DESCRCONTROLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || :TELA || '%') OR (:TELA IS NULL)) AND :TIPO = 'P' AND USU.NOMEUSU = :USUARIO GROUP BY CON.DESCRCONTROLE ) GROUP BY OPC_MENU, PERC ORDER BY VALOR_TOTAL DESC, VALOR_PERIODO DESC
